# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `paypal` MCP server pointing at PayPal's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.paypal.com/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.1 with Dynamic Client Registration and PKCE — no access token or client credentials to configure.
- Logo: PayPal's official mark, from `paypalobjects.com`.
